item.title: Futamata Yarou to Papakatsu Shimai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DESSERT Soft
  • 発売日: 2024-02-22
  • スコア: 6.7299999999999995/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 二股野郎とパパ活姉妹
  • 英語名: Futamata Yarou to Papakatsu Shimai

别名

  • Hutapapa

あらすじ

The two big-breasted beautiful sisters are the center of attention in the class, and the slave who serves as their wallet.

Matou Kei, a gloomy and unattractive otaku, was like an extra to his childhood friends, sisters who live next door to him.

The sisters are so close that they often come to his room to hang out, however, when someone asks if they are dating, they deny it.

item.title: Namaiki JK Library
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DESSERT Soft
  • 発売日: 2022-05-27
  • スコア: 6.909999999999999/10 (55 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ナマイキJKライブラリー
  • 英語名: Namaiki JK Library

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kiritani Haruto, a 35-year-old socially awkward virgin, works as a librarian at a school where he is generally avoided and considered creepy by most students. Recently, his only solace comes from interactions with busty high school girls who engage in the “library attendance” system, a unique arrangement where students can avoid regular classes by studying in the library. The girls tease and mock Haruto, but secretly harbor a fondness for him, using the library time to confide in him about their troubles. Despite the awkward dynamics, the girls find ways to subtly enjoy moments of intimacy with Haruto while maintaining a facade of taking jabs at him in public.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: DESSERT Soft
  • 発売日: 2020-01-31
  • スコア: 7.0/10 (63 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 神様のしっぽ ～干支神さまたちの恩返し～
  • 英語名: Kamisama no Shippo Etogami-sama tachi no Ongaeshi

あらすじ

In the remote village of Tenbu, watched over by the gods, lies a shrine where the twelve zodiac signs are enshrined. Akinari is a young man who had been taken in by the Asatsuki family that currently runs the shrine when he was a baby. He secretly possesses a mysterious ability: he can understand what animals say. Since he likes animals more than others, he used this power to enjoy his life every day.
